parameters.content:
## Customer Re-engagement
Wins back past customers who stopped coming. At 30, 60 and 90 days after their last visit they get one friendly email each: a check-in, an invitation back, then an honest 'what could we do better'. Replies stop the emails and land in your inbox.

**Setup (10 minutes)**
1. Make a Google Sheet with a tab called **Customers** and these headers in row 1:
`Name | Email | Phone | Last Visit | Last Service | Status | Win-back Stage | Last Message | Notes | Last Reply`
2. Paste its URL into the four Google Sheets nodes.
3. Connect Gmail, Google Sheets and Google Gemini (free key from aistudio.google.com).
4. Fill in **Your Settings**.
5. Add a test customer with your own email and a Last Visit 31 days ago, click **Execute workflow**.
6. Turn the workflow on.

### Your Settings
**winBackDays**: the gaps that trigger an email, `30,60,90`.
**comeBackOffer**: e.g. `10% off your next visit`. Leave it empty and the AI is not allowed to mention any deal.
**dailyLimit**: max emails per run.
**useAI**: false = built-in templates only.

### Who gets an email
Only customers with a **Last Visit** and a valid email. One email per stage, never several at once. When they come back, update **Last Visit** and the count starts over. Status **Stop** or **Unsubscribed** means never email again. Status **Replied** pauses them until their next visit.

### Writing the email
Gemini's free tier writes each email from their last service. If the AI mentions a deal you did not set, or fails, a ready-made template is sent instead. Every email ends with an easy STOP line.
